prior_limits: Pooled TTFT MAIN/HOLD/LONG reductions 4.210/3.827/5.074%; confirmation strict global gate was false; no native or decode gain inferred.
hypothesis: Eager native DFlash suffix prefill needlessly computes and reads 248320 target logits for each intermediate row. Skip only these unused heads, preserving every token-major trunk, capture, append, state transition and final real logits.
semantics: 1 computes a target head only on the final row of each nonempty DFlash prefill/extend_prefill call; 0 computes every row. AR, MTP and speculative verification remain unchanged.
cache_contract: native_prompt_cache stores real logits returned by each completed whole suffix; empty-suffix hits reuse genuine saved logits. Never skip the final head of any extend_prefill call or publish missing/stale logits.
quality: Strict full-width 248320 finite half logits, hidden, every 84 continuation tensors, draft captures/KV and offsets versus HEADS0; nonempty shapes and bytes.
Actual test-only counter at real target head submission: N to 1 per nonempty call, one per split suffix call, no release counter.
Lengths 1/2/3/9, split prefill and saved prefix restore, continuation, invalid token/empty/context errors, cancellation/reset/recovery.
Real production bridge DFlash1 reuse off and cache on hit/extended suffix; identical output hashes/modes/counters before timing. Existing AR/MTP independent controls remain required.
verification: Rust format/strict Clippy, CPU and direct/chat and compatibility suites; release build.
Kani on real CPU head-selection helper across all usize positions/lengths and both flags; record unsupported compiler/timeouts. Test-only mutation restoring eager heads must fail counter regression.
No GPU concurrent with compilers/provers/other models; exclusive slot granted by root.

timing.claim: Native gain unmeasured. Decode is an unchanged control; do not transfer historic percentages.

integration: isolated worktree; no installed app replacement/merge/release; MTP follow-up separate
